title: Kobalos Infiltration
description: Investigate a Kobalos-infected Linux system and identify indicators of compromise.
outcomes: Analyze network traffic for suspicious activity

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: Welcome to the Kobalos Infiltration scenario. Your goal is to investigate a compromised Linux system and identify indicators of compromise related to the Kobalos malware.

levels.title: Access the Sandbox
levels.cloud_content: Connect to the cloud-based sandbox using SSH with username cyrano and password cyrano.
levels.local_content: Launch a local VM instance with the provided configuration.

levels.title: Identify Kobalos Infection
levels.content: Investigate the target host for signs of Kobalos infection. Look for unusual activity or known indicators of compromise (IOCs) associated with Kobalos.
levels.solution: Use tools like netstat, lsof, or ps to inspect open network connections and running processes. Check for suspicious files or processes related to Kobalos.

hints.title: First hint
hints.content: Check the process list for any unusual activity.

hints.title: Second hint
hints.content: Look for known indicators of compromise (IOCs) associated with Kobalos.

levels.title: Analyze Network Traffic
levels.content: Analyze the target host's network traffic for signs of Kobalos communication. Look for unusual activity or known indicators of compromise (IOCs) associated with Kobalos.
levels.solution: Use tools like tcpdump, Wireshark, or tshark to capture and analyze network traffic. Check for suspicious connections related to Kobalos.

hints.title: First hint
hints.content: Capture network traffic using tcpdump or Wireshark.

hints.title: Second hint
hints.content: Look for known indicators of compromise (IOCs) associated with Kobalos in the captured network traffic.

reference_solution.cmd: tshark -r capture.pcap -T fields -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e tcp.port | grep 7070
reference_solution.cmd_regex: tshark -r capture.pcap -T fields -e ip.src -e ip.dst -e tcp.port | grep 7070
